entries.headline: Sid Meier's Civilization VII will add a fourth age in a free 2027 update
entries.summary: 2K announced Arc of Tomorrow, a major free update for Sid Meier's Civilization VII due in 2027 that will extend the game with a fourth age. The report also references the first paid expansion, Earthrise.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report relays 2K's announcement and supports the update name, 2027 window, fourth-age positioning, and Earthrise reference. Earthrise appeared in the adjacent edition, so this item leads with the new Arc of Tomorrow details.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer says 2K announced the update on September 6, 2026 in Japan, within the fixed window; the packet provides no precise time.

entries.headline: AUTOMATON revisits Umineko When They Cry's meta-mystery structure and themes
entries.summary: An AUTOMATON feature examines how Umineko uses clashes between red and blue truth to explore truth, understanding, and the idea that without love it cannot be seen, rather than merely retelling the plot.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON feature supports the article's analytical focus. This item summarizes its stated narrative mechanisms and themes without presenting the author's interpretation as an official conclusion.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the feature at 02:39 UTC on September 6, within the fixed evidence window.

entries.headline: DON'T NOD says its ability to continue operating depends on securing external financing
entries.summary: DON'T NOD reported first-half 2026 revenue of €6.1 million, down 14% year over year, while operating revenue fell 56%. The company said its ability to continue operating partly depends on obtaining external financing.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays DON'T NOD's September 4 first-half results, the revenue figures, and the financing-related going-concern risk. The packet does not include a separately opened primary filing, so this is classified as a media relay of official information.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 01:51 UTC on September 7, within the fixed evidence window.

entries.headline: Game designer breaks down boss-battle design through Yoshi's Island and other examples
entries.summary: An AUTOMATON developer column uses Big Sluggy from World 5 of Yoshi's Island and other examples to examine how specific mechanics let boss fights serve broader level-design and pacing roles.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON column identifies its author as a game designer and specifically discusses the World 5 boss from Yoshi's Island. This item is limited to the article's analytical subject and angle.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the column at 05:59 UTC on September 6, within the fixed evidence window.

entries.headline: Mewgenics update adds Simplified Chinese and three other languages
entries.summary: Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel released a Mewgenics update adding Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Simplified Chinese display support after prior translation testing.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays the developers' update and supports the four added languages. The Simplified Chinese title follows the repository's official Steam-backed title registry.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published the report at 01:33 UTC on September 7, within the fixed evidence window.
